checks.name: beats_best_point_baseline_all
checks.rationale: Expected points must be at least as accurate (RMSE) as the best naive/domain baseline.

checks.name: beats_best_point_baseline_regulars
checks.rationale: The decision-relevant population (regular starters) must not be worse either.

checks.name: competitive_with_direct_regressor
checks.rationale: The decomposition may cost at most 0.02 RMSE vs a direct GBM; it must earn its keep via distributions and explanations.

checks.name: crps_beats_climatology
checks.rationale: The distribution must be more informative than a position × role climatology.

checks.name: central_80_coverage_pit
checks.rationale: Share of outcomes inside the model's central 80% (randomised PIT, valid for discrete outcomes).

checks.name: haul_probability_calibrated
checks.rationale: P(points ≥ 6) is shown to users and drives captaincy upside.

checks.name: start_brier_beats_rate_baseline
checks.rationale: P(start) must beat the recency-weighted start-rate baseline.

checks.name: start_probability_calibrated
checks.rationale: Start probabilities are displayed and drive bench decisions.

checks.name: minutes_mae_beats_rate_baseline
checks.rationale: Expected minutes must be more accurate than the baseline.
